items.body:
After claude code finished the job I asked it: "By the way what is Grag you tried to invoke?"
She answered:
That was a typo on my part — I meant to call Grep but fat-fingered it as Grag. It errored immediately ("No such tool available"), so I just called Grep correctly on the next attempt. Not an actual tool, just a slip.

It can be a new attack surface, relying on LLMs typos!
